title: account_asset — fixed asset depreciation deep L3 (Community presence check)
key_finding: account_asset is an Enterprise-only module; it is completely absent from the Odoo 19.0 Community source tree. Fixed asset depreciation, the depreciation board computation, depreciation journal entry generation, and asset disposal workflows are all unavailable in Community.
c1_risk_description: Fixed asset accounting capability is fully absent from Community. Any migration requiring PP&E schedule management, accumulated depreciation tracking, or asset disposal accounting must either license Enterprise, source a third-party community module, or accept manual journal-entry-only workarounds.

claims.technical_statement: The account_asset module directory does not exist in the Odoo 19 Community source tree under odoo/addons.
claims.neutral_ref: Fixed asset depreciation is not shipped as part of the standard community accounting suite

claims.technical_statement: No account.asset ORM model exists in Community; the asset record, depreciation method fields, and state machine are absent.
claims.neutral_ref: The data model for tracking individual depreciable assets does not exist in the community edition

claims.technical_statement: No depreciation board computation function (linear or degressive monthly/annual schedule) exists in Community source.
claims.neutral_ref: Automated generation of depreciation schedule entries over an asset lifespan is not available in the community build

claims.technical_statement: No account_asset extension of account.move exists; the debit Depreciation Expense / credit Accumulated Depreciation journal entry creation logic is absent.
claims.neutral_ref: The mechanism that posts periodic depreciation charges as double-entry journal lines does not exist in community

claims.technical_statement: No asset disposal/write-off method exists in Community; final disposal entry computation, gain/loss on disposal, and asset closure workflow are absent.
claims.neutral_ref: The workflow and accounting entries for removing a depreciated asset from the balance sheet are not present in community
